prompt: Fix the shell-snapshot cache bug in codex-rs/exec-server. A transient profile/snapshot capture failure is currently cached for the lifetime of the entry, so later commands keep using the fallback even after the profile is repaired. Failed captures should be retried after a short bounded backoff, concurrent requests must share each attempt, fallback execution must remain available during failures/backoff, and the final failure should remain cached after the retry budget is exhausted. Inspect the repository, implement the smallest correct fix, and run focused native tests. Do not commit changes.

Fix rollout reconstruction for nested agent forks. When a fork removes the associated task/user message but a full world-state snapshot survives, the reconstructed session can lose its world-state/reference-context baseline and later duplicate or omit developer/environment context. Restore previous turn settings and the reference/world-state baseline only from a surviving full snapshot; partial snapshots and snapshots superseded by compaction must not become baselines. Keep rollback user-turn semantics unchanged. Inspect the repository, implement the smallest correct fix, and run focused native tests. Do not commit changes.

Fix session configuration updates so changing only app-server client name/version preserves the existing permission snapshot. A managed restricted filesystem policy with writable and nested denied paths must not be re-resolved or altered by metadata-only updates. Working-directory changes must still perform any required project-root rebinding. Inspect the repository, implement the smallest correct fix, and run focused native tests. Do not commit changes.

Fix reviewed unified-exec terminal input handling. Manual approval shell-quotes proposed stdin, which cannot faithfully represent a NUL byte. Reject any proposed reviewed input containing a NUL before creating an approval request and before sending any portion to the terminal. Preserve existing oversized-input rejection and ordinary input behavior. Inspect the repository, implement the smallest correct fix, and run focused native tests. Do not commit changes.

Fix remote environment registration recovery. Retry only an explicit HTTP 503 response whose error code is registration_conflict, using cancellable jittered backoff. Ambiguous timeouts, malformed bodies, other status codes, and other error codes must remain terminal because replay could replace a newer registration. Preserve the Noise identity and initialized session across a successful retry, and apply the existing connection timeout to response-body diagnostics. Inspect the repository, implement the smallest correct fix, and run focused native tests. Do not commit changes.

Fix Unix PTY I/O so runtime shutdown cannot be blocked by a detached child retaining the terminal or by output-channel backpressure. PTY reads and writes must be asynchronously readiness-driven and cancellable; closing stdin must preserve queued input and deliver EOF; a dropped output receiver must not stop child-output draining; and spawning without a Tokio I/O driver should return a descriptive error. Preserve non-Unix behavior. Inspect the repository, implement the smallest correct fix, and run focused native tests. Do not commit changes.

Harden Windows file-URI conversion in codex-rs/utils/path-uri. Percent-encoded drive colons must still identify Windows paths for convention inference, native path rendering, and same-drive relative joins. Percent-encoded slash or backslash separators must be rejected before native conversion can reinterpret URI segment boundaries, including UNC forms. Preserve POSIX and ordinary unencoded Windows URI behavior. Inspect the repository, implement the smallest correct fix, and run focused native tests. Do not commit changes.
